headline: Learned predictors and virtual screens prioritize ligands for prospective validation
label: Drug Target Binding Prediction
summary: Generative and predictive models now propose receptor and PPI ligands that are tested experimentally, linking in silico scores to measured activity.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational prioritization of candidate ligands and binding partners, where predicted scores or generated candidates are narrowed before experimental testing. SpaceGFN constructs programmable molecular spaces from building blocks and reaction rules using a GFlowNet generator. G-LEAP combines protein language models with 3D geometric ligand representations to predict over 120M GPCR-metabolome interactions. The TLR5 study pairs transcriptome-based lead generation with ligand and docking prioritization, and ELISA confirmed TLR5 activation by nine top leads. The Chrebp/Txnip study uses a generative RNN to design selective Chrebp/14-3-3 PPI inhibitors, prioritized by MD and MM/PBSA and validated in THP-1 macrophages. What is new is the pairing of generative or learned predictors with prospective experimental validation.
